meaning: の links two nouns · possession · description · belonging
gist: の sits between nouns: AのB ≈ "B of A" / "A's B." Possession: [私|わたし]の[本|ほん]. Description: [日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]. Belonging / group: [大学|だいがく]の[学生|がくせい]. Do not drop の (×日本語先生). Pointing words like この[本|ほん] come later — different job from [私|わたし]の[本|ほん].

rows: [日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]です
[大学|だいがく]の[学生|がくせい]です
[傘|かさ]は[誰|だれ]の[傘|かさ]ですか
formation.note: Order is modifierのhead — [私|わたし]の[本|ほん], not ×本の私 for "my book." の does not replace は: [私|わたし]の[本|ほん]は… when you need a topic.

explanation: の joins two nouns so the first modifies the second. Possession is the clearest case: 私の本 "my book." The same linker describes kind or field — 日本語の先生 "a Japanese-language teacher" — and belonging or group — 大学の学生 "a university student," 学校の先生 "a school teacher." Questions keep か: 傘はだれの傘ですか / 本は私のです. Never glue the nouns with no linker (×日本語先生). この本 ("this book") is a later pointing form; it is not the same as 私の本 ("my book").

senses.label: Description / kind
senses.body: Field or type before the role noun.
senses.example_ruby: [日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]です。

senses.label: Belonging / group
senses.body: Organization or place linked to the person or thing.
senses.example_ruby: [大学|だいがく]の[学生|がくせい]です。

senses.label: Whose…? / mine
senses.body: [誰|だれ]の asks whose; [私|わたし]のです means "mine" when the noun is clear.

register_context: Default polite: NのNです / NのNですか. Plain/casual: NのNだ. Same です/だ and か habits as earlier lessons — teach です first.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [日本語|にほんご][先生|せんせい]です。
mistakes.right_ruby: [日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]です。
mistakes.why: Nouns need の between them. Dropping の (×日本語先生) is ungrammatical.
Possession also requires の: 私の本, not ×私本.
Modifier comes first: ownerのthing. ×本の私 does not mean "my book."
Do not insert topic は inside the の link. For "my book" as the predicate, use 私の本です.

contrasts.label: 私の本 vs この本
contrasts.summary: の links a noun owner/kind (私の本). この marks pointing + noun (この本) — taught in kono-sono-ano.
contrasts.ex_b_en: It's this book. (pointing この — later lesson)

contrasts.label: Possession vs description
contrasts.summary: Same の linker: ownerのthing vs fieldのrole — meaning comes from the nouns, not a different particle.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [田中|たなか]さんの[傘|かさ]です。
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]です。

examples.ruby: [日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]です。
[大学|だいがく]の[学生|がくせい]です。
[田中|たなか]さんの[鞄|かばん]です。
[学校|がっこう]の[先生|せんせい]です。
[傘|かさ]は[誰|だれ]の[傘|かさ]ですか。
[日本|にほん]の[会社|かいしゃ]です。
[私|わたし]の[友達|ともだち]は[医者|いしゃ]です。
[猫|ねこ]は[山田|やまだ]さんの[猫|ねこ]です。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.ruby: [山田|やまだ]さんは[日本語|にほんご]の[先生|せんせい]ですか。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: はい、[大学|だいがく]の[先生|せんせい]です。

checks.why: Noun + noun needs の (日本語の先生). は marks topic; か marks questions.
Possession is 私の本. ×はの stacks topic inside the link; だ is the plain copula, not the noun linker.
"Whose" uses だれの. どこ/いつ ask where/when, not owner.
私の本 is possession with の. この本 is pointing (later). ×日本語先生 drops required の.
